init_retargeter: initialize a Retargeter with MotionConfig and RetargetConfig to load and preprocess a BVH motion file
compute_orientations: compute bone orientations for a character joint by projecting BVH proximal and distal joints onto a 2D plane
get_retargeted_frame_data: get retargeted joint orientations, depths, and root position for a given time in seconds
scale_root_positions_for_character: scale BVH root positions for a character using a projection plane and character-to-BVH scale ratio
determine_projection_plane_normal: determine a projection plane normal for a joint group using frontal, sagittal, or PCA methods
